nodes.name: Graph Inference Connectome Atoms
nodes.description: Algorithmic primitives for neural circuit reconstruction from calcium fluorescence time series

nodes.name: calcium_lowpass_filter
nodes.description: Apply a causal or acausal weighted moving average to a time series matrix using circular shift
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Applying a causal or acausal weighted moving average performs a constant number of matrix additions and circular shifts along the time axis, scaling linearly with the total elements T * N.

nodes.name: fluorescence_hard_threshold
nodes.description: Zero all values below a threshold, keeping values above unchanged, to isolate co-activation events
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Thresholding the fluorescence matrix performs an element-wise comparison and mask assignment, scaling linearly with the total number of elements T * N.

nodes.name: global_activity_sample_reweighting
nodes.description: Nonlinear per-timestep reweighting that suppresses global burst periods and amplifies selective co-activation
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Computing global activity and applying non-linear exponentiation per timestep requires linear time and space relative to the total number of elements T * N.

nodes.name: temporal_precedence_directivity
nodes.description: Compute asymmetric directional connectivity score via temporal lag counting in a specific response interval
nodes.type_signature: (X: NDArray[np.float64], low: float = 0.2, high: float = 0.5) -> NDArray[np.float64]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Computing asymmetric directivity scores requires evaluating temporal lag precedence for all N^2 ordered neuron pairs over T timesteps, taking O(N^2 * T) time.

nodes.name: score_matrix_normalization
nodes.description: Normalize a score matrix to [0, 1] with diagonal set to minimum, removing self-connections
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Normalizing the score matrix requires calculating the global minimum and maximum, and scaling all elements, which runs in quadratic time and space with respect to the number of nodes N.
